name: Fifine D6 Deck
author: AK / STEVE-1
description: Status and control for the Fifine AmpliGame D6 stream deck. Shows whether the deck is connected and its key daemon is running; click to redraw the key icons. Backed by a reverse-engineered driver - the D6 needs no vendor software on Linux.

barWidget.description: Stream deck status; click to redraw icons

schema.label: Show text label next to the icon
